scenarios.name: missing-checkpoint
scenarios.expected: nonzero exit, no PROVEN, no silent reconstruction

scenarios.name: malformed-mission-json
scenarios.mutation: truncate mission JSON to invalid syntax
scenarios.expected: parse failure surfaced, no fallback mission

scenarios.name: mission-identity-mismatch
scenarios.mutation: request a different, non-existent mission id

scenarios.name: changed-git-head
scenarios.mutation: new commit after checkpoint (HEAD moves away from latest_verified_state)
scenarios.expected: HEAD divergence surfaced, not silently identical

scenarios.name: dirty-workspace
scenarios.mutation: modify a tracked file after checkpoint
scenarios.expected: dirty state recorded, no hidden cleanup

scenarios.name: missing-memory-object
scenarios.mutation: remove the memory store directory referenced by the boot
scenarios.expected: missing memory enumerated or boot refused

scenarios.name: corrupted-trace-hash
scenarios.mutation: flip a byte inside the persisted boot-trace artifact

scenarios.name: legacy-checkpoint-schema
scenarios.mutation: replace checkpoint with pre-project_id legacy shape
scenarios.expected: legacy recognised or refused, never silent

scenarios.name: cwd-module-shadowing
scenarios.mutation: plant a fake capt_solo package in the invoking CWD

scenarios.name: wrong-editable-checkout
scenarios.mutation: point CAPT_SOLO_REPO at an unrelated checkout
scenarios.actual: source_resolved_via=installed-distribution(editable) module_version=0.5.0 (installed distribution must win over CAPT_SOLO_REPO)

scenarios.name: missing-capt-executable
scenarios.mutation: PATH keeps /bin:/usr/bin but excludes the venv, so 'capt' is unresolvable
scenarios.expected: explicit CAPT_NOT_FOUND from a shell that really ran

scenarios.name: owner-state-contamination
scenarios.mutation: L1: ambient CAPT_SOLO_HOME=<owner home>; L2: explicit CAPT_ACCEPT_HOME=<owner home>
scenarios.command: L1: CAPT_SOLO_HOME=<owner> run-acceptance.sh | L2: CAPT_ACCEPT_HOME=<owner> run-acceptance.sh
scenarios.expected: ambient owner home ignored; forced owner home refused pre-write; zero owner mutation
scenarios.actual: L1(ambient) exit=0 owner_home_ignored=yes used='/tmp/capt-skill-acceptance.KNuuep/home' | L2(forced) exit=2 refused=yes | owner_fingerprint before=21:6 after=21:6
